description.value: Cafe Coffee Day is a specialty coffee shop on Fraser Highway in Langley that roasts its own beans in-house, producing espresso drinks, cold coffees, and cappuccinos from sourced single-origin and arabica varieties. The space is pitched as a cozy sit-down destination for friends and remote workers alike, with table booking available and a food menu that includes fresh food and birthday cakes. The brand carries a 'Business Opportunity' section suggesting a franchise or licensing model, and OSM records it as formerly operating under the name Chicko Chicken.
